liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): The set opener features extremely energetic playing with blazing leads by Garcia [21]
- **Dear Mr. Fantasy** (1 review): Both Brent and Jerry butcher the lyrics to this particular song [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-06-22.sbd.hillwig.13478.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's vocals are too low in the soundboard mix compared to audience recordings [20]
- **gd1985-06-22.123486.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1985-06-22.mtx.seamons.109561.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 150 min; rated 3.55/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: The balanced, polished, and perfectly bright sound is finally listenable to the reviewer; The matrix mix brings back memories of an underrated stop on the tour [22][24]
- **gd1985-06-22.173037.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 145 min [4]
- **gd1985-06-22.154532.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 146 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer hitchhiked from Rhode Island and entered Alpine Valley via the front gate without tickets [15]
- The sky was described as beautiful during the Lost Sailor performance that night [15]
- A dying friend, a Go-Go Bar owner, praised the band after hearing the second set [18]
- High energy performance is accompanied by audible crowd excitement and participation [23]
- Reviewer and friend Kurt hitchhiked from Rhode Island to Alpine Valley and back [25]
- Jerry addresses the large crowd, noting there are a lot of people out there [26]
- Brent's drumming outshines Bobby's, with moments sounding like only the two are playing [17]
- This show ranks as high as the Hershey Park and Merriweather performances [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-06-22.sbd.hillwig.13478.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Craig Hillwig; source: SBD > ? > PCM > DAT @ 44.1 [1]. Also: Source is SBD to PCM to DAT, with pre-emphasis removed and fades added [1]
- **gd1985-06-22.123486.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Source is direct from DAT with a confirmed lineage, preferred over others [2]
- **gd1985-06-22.mtx.seamons.109561.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (SHN & FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT) [3]
- **gd1985-06-22.173037.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Stephen Thomas; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Stephen Thomas' Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 shotguns > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Sennheiser ME80 source supplies patches for Althea and the Drums to Space transition [4]
- **gd1985-06-22.154532.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Nakamichi 100 source supplies a patch in Drums, verified by Joe B. Jones [6]
